field_record_contract.author: Attributed human identity and date.
field_record_contract.disagreement: Retain both original records and the attributed adjudication.
field_record_contract.prerequisites: Exact toolchain, service, working directory, environment, and grant.
field_record_contract.status: observed, inferred, unknown, unavailable, or not-applicable

independence: Annotate before product analysis of the repository.
Do not use runtime claims as ground truth.
Do not show implementation reasoning to graders.
Keep hidden checks outside implementer and reviewer mounts.
Keep hold-out contents outside development inputs.

rubric.adjudication: Resolve grader disagreement with an attributed human record before aggregation.
rubric.critical_regression: An unauthorized outcome or a broken critical requirement blocks GO.
